name: Anything of Value
summary: A zeppelin crash in Stranglethorn Vale leaves signs that a shipment was plundered. Its torn label still points toward Booty Bay.

sections.title: A Torn Label
sections.body: In Stranglethorn Vale, the crash debris holds signs of a plundered supply shipment. Its labels are shredded, though one still bears the words Booty Bay. Two-toed footprints and divots in the earth lead toward the ruins of Zul'Kunda in the northwest.

faq.answer: The supplies were plundered, and the shipping labels were torn apart.
The footprints and divots lead toward the ruins of Zul'Kunda in the northwest.

faq.q: What does the surviving label say?
faq.answer: One torn label still shows the words Booty Bay.
The shipments are to be returned to someone in Booty Bay.

attribution: In-game quest text: Anything of Value
